dialogues.jp: たまの日曜日。
dialogues.en: It's Sunday today.
dialogues.text: It's Sunday today.

dialogues.jp:
商店街も活気というか、休日の少々落ち着きの
ない空気を帯びている。
dialogues.en: The shopping mall is as lively as it always is on a weekend.
dialogues.text: The shopping mall is as lively as it always is on a weekend.

dialogues.jp:
３月から４月はずっと天気もよく、赤い桜の花
びらが、今日も空気の成分のひとつのように空
を舞っている。
dialogues.en:
The weather's always good from March to April, and velvety
cherry petals flutter in the air as usual.
dialogues.text:
The weather's always good from March to April, and velvety
cherry petals flutter in the air as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜、日曜日ってのはいいもんだ」
dialogues.en: "Hm... I like Sunday."
dialogues.text: "Hm... I like Sunday."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ババくさいな……」
dialogues.en: "You sound like an old woman."
dialogues.text: "You sound like an old woman."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんに言われたくないよ」
dialogues.en: "I don't want to hear that from you."
dialogues.text: "I don't want to hear that from you."

dialogues.jp:
猫を頭の上にのっけて、さくらが講師のように
指をたてる。
dialogues.en:
With the cat on her head, Sakura puts her finger up like a
teacher.
dialogues.text:
With the cat on her head, Sakura puts her finger up like a
teacher.

dialogues.jp: 「そうか。講師の監視つきの休みになるわけか」
dialogues.en:
"I see. My weekends are going to be monitored by a teacher,
is that right?"
dialogues.text:
"I see. My weekends are going to be monitored by a teacher,
is that right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ドント・ウォーリー♪　休みのときまで先生
　は、やらないよぉ」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry! I won't be a teacher at the weekend."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry! I won't be a teacher at the weekend."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ま、どのみち後ろめたいことなんてするつも
　りもないがな……かったりぃ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I don't plan to do anything incriminating... Oh, such
a pain in the neck."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I don't plan to do anything incriminating... Oh, such
a pain in the neck."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへへ♪」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha..."

dialogues.jp: さくらが俺の手をにぎった。
dialogues.en: Sakura holds my hand.
dialogues.text: Sakura holds my hand.

dialogues.jp:
無言で握り返すと、繋ぐというよりも、包み込
むといった状態になる。
dialogues.en:
I silently squeeze her hand in return, which was more like
wrapping than holding for me.
dialogues.text:
I silently squeeze her hand in return, which was more like
wrapping than holding for me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ……恋人さん」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha... We're lovers..."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha... We're lovers..."

dialogues.jp:
あらためてさくらの顔を見つめると、なぜだか
妙に恥ずかしくなってきてしまう。
dialogues.en: I rub my mouth and my nose itches.
dialogues.text: I rub my mouth and my nose itches.

dialogues.jp:
繋いだふたりの手に、きのうまでとは違う、｛・／意｝
｛・／味｝が出来たことも意識してしまう。
dialogues.en:
Our relationship has changed since last night, but it's not
much different from before.
dialogues.text:
Our relationship has changed since last night, but it's not
much different from before.

dialogues.jp:
今、誰かに冷やかされたら、なんだか分からな
いが耐えられそうにないな。
dialogues.en:
I feel embarrassed to think that holding her hand means
something different from before.
dialogues.text:
I feel embarrassed to think that holding her hand means
something different from before.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お昼どうしよっか？」
dialogues.en: If somebody teased me now, I don't think I can handle it.
dialogues.text: If somebody teased me now, I don't think I can handle it.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな……ハンバーガーでも買って食うか」
dialogues.en: "What do you want to do for lunch?"
dialogues.text: "What do you want to do for lunch?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん。もっと、こう恋人らしい食事にしよー
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm... Lovers should eat more romantic food. Besides, a
hamburger in Japan is too expensive."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm... Lovers should eat more romantic food. Besides, a
hamburger in Japan is too expensive."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ファミレスじゃないレストランとか、回らな
　い寿司屋にでも行けというのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Are you saying to go to a restaurant that's not a family
restaurant, or a sushi bar without a rotating conveyor?"
dialogues.text:
"Are you saying to go to a restaurant that's not a family
restaurant, or a sushi bar without a rotating conveyor?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、普段の食生活の推察できる言葉だね」
dialogues.en: "Hmm. It shows a lot that I can tell your eating habits."
dialogues.text: "Hmm. It shows a lot that I can tell your eating habits."

dialogues.jp:
ぐにゃぐにゃ、とさくらが頭を傾けると、猫が
落ちそうになる。
dialogues.en: When Sakura turns her head slowly, the cat almost falls off.
dialogues.text: When Sakura turns her head slowly, the cat almost falls off.

dialogues.jp:
それをそっと支えながら、考える……恋人っぽ
い食事か。
dialogues.en: I catch the cat, and try to think of food for lovers.
dialogues.text: I catch the cat, and try to think of food for lovers.

dialogues.jp: 「牛丼？」
dialogues.en: "How about a beef bowl?"
dialogues.text: "How about a beef bowl?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ハンバーガーにしよう……テイクアウトして
　外で食べるほうが、まだ風情があるよ」
dialogues.en:
"Let's order a hamburger to go. It's tastier eating
outside."
dialogues.text:
"Let's order a hamburger to go. It's tastier eating
outside."

dialogues.jp:
さくらに引っ張られるまま、馴染み深い匂いと
音のする店にはいった。
dialogues.en:
Sakura drags me into the restaurant with familiar smells and
sounds.
dialogues.text:
Sakura drags me into the restaurant with familiar smells and
sounds.

dialogues.jp: それなら牛丼でも変わらないと思いながら。
dialogues.en: Trying to think how this is different from a beef bowl.
dialogues.text: Trying to think how this is different from a beef bowl.

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございましたー」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much..."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much..."

dialogues.jp: なんだかふたりして気まずく店を出る。
dialogues.en: We leave the restaurant feeling awkward.
dialogues.text: We leave the restaurant feeling awkward.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、まぁ、気にするな」
dialogues.en: "Oh, don't worry."
dialogues.text: "Oh, don't worry."

dialogues.jp:
セットメニューでもらった、子供用の玩具を見
つめるさくらの頭に手をのせる。
dialogues.en:
I place my hand on Sakura's head as she glares at a toy
prize that came with the combination meal she ordered.
dialogues.text:
I place my hand on Sakura's head as she glares at a toy
prize that came with the combination meal she ordered.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「むぅ、そこまで気にしてないけどさぁ……妹
　扱いは許せないよね」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm, I don't care, but it's very rude to think I'm your
younger sister."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm, I don't care, but it's very rude to think I'm your
younger sister."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「しゃーないだろう、背の高さは。それに俺の
　ことお兄ちゃんって呼んでんだから」
dialogues.en:
"What else can you do with your height? Plus, you were
calling me 'oniichan', weren't you?"
dialogues.text:
"What else can you do with your height? Plus, you were
calling me 'oniichan', weren't you?"

dialogues.jp:
紙袋の中身の商品を確かめながら、小さくため
息をつく。
dialogues.en: She exhales, looking at the toy in the paper bag.
dialogues.text: She exhales, looking at the toy in the paper bag.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
さくらが目をぐるぐる、と回してから俺を見上
げた。
dialogues.en: Blinking her eyes, Sakura looks at me.
dialogues.text: Blinking her eyes, Sakura looks at me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「呼び方で印象って変わるかな？」
dialogues.en:
"Do you think people's impression will be changed by what I
call you?"
dialogues.text:
"Do you think people's impression will be changed by what I
call you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、お兄ちゃんって呼んでれば、普通は妹
　だと思うだろうな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, as long as you call me 'oniichan', they think you are
my younger oneechanter."
dialogues.text:
"Well, as long as you call me 'oniichan', they think you are
my younger oneechanter."

dialogues.jp:
お兄ちゃんと呼びながら恋仲だなんて、うちら
かゲームの中の話くらいだろう。
dialogues.en:
You call me 'oniichan', but we're in love. That kind of
thing normally only happens in erotic games.
dialogues.text:
You call me 'oniichan', but we're in love. That kind of
thing normally only happens in erotic games.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あははは。じゃあ、パパとかご主人様って呼
　んだら、どうなるんだろうね？」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha. If I call you 'papa' or 'my master', how do you
think they'd respond to us?"
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha. If I call you 'papa' or 'my master', how do you
think they'd respond to us?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや……無茶やろそれは」
dialogues.en: "Well, I think it's impossible."
dialogues.text: "Well, I think it's impossible."

dialogues.jp:
パパは俺の年齢的に、ご主人様は倫理的にまず
い。いいけどまずい。
dialogues.en: 'Papa' is too old for my age, and 'my master' is just wrong.
dialogues.text: 'Papa' is too old for my age, and 'my master' is just wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「面白くない？」
dialogues.en: "But, doesn't it sound fun?"
dialogues.text: "But, doesn't it sound fun?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……俺を犯罪者にするつもりか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sending me to jail?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sending me to jail?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫だって……ね、パパ♪」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry, papa!"
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, papa!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なんで鼻を押さえてるのパパ？　早く行かな
　いとハンバーガー冷めちゃうよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Why do you hold your nose, papa? We'd better get going,
otherwise the hamburgers will get cold."
dialogues.text:
"Why do you hold your nose, papa? We'd better get going,
otherwise the hamburgers will get cold."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「からかうのはやめぃ……」
dialogues.en: "Stop teasing me now..."
dialogues.text: "Stop teasing me now..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あははははは」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha!"
dialogues.text: "Hahaha!"

dialogues.jp:
目を細めて｛うめ／呻｝くが、俺を引っ張りながら笑うさ
くらには聞こえていないらしい。
dialogues.en:
I glared and told her to stop, but it seems she didn't hear
me since she was dragging me along and laughing.
dialogues.text:
I glared and told her to stop, but it seems she didn't hear
me since she was dragging me along and laughing.

dialogues.jp: 「かったりぃ」
dialogues.en: "Such a pain in the neck."
dialogues.text: "Such a pain in the neck."

dialogues.jp:
本当に、日曜日に子供を遊びに連れて行かなく
てはいけない親のような気分だ。
dialogues.en:
I really feel like I'm a parent who had to take my kid out
on Sunday.
dialogues.text:
I really feel like I'm a parent who had to take my kid out
on Sunday.

dialogues.jp:
でも、さくらの嬉しそうな顔を見れるのだから、
悪くはない。
dialogues.en: But I like it because I can see Sakura's happy face.
dialogues.text: But I like it because I can see Sakura's happy face.

dialogues.jp: 「しゃーないな。どこで食う？」
dialogues.en: "What the hell! Where do you wanna eat?"
dialogues.text: "What the hell! Where do you wanna eat?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「公園に行こうよ。高台からなら海が見えて気
　持ち良いよ！」
dialogues.en:
"Let's go to the park. You can see the ocean from the hill
and it's beautiful!"
dialogues.text:
"Let's go to the park. You can see the ocean from the hill
and it's beautiful!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと遠いな」
dialogues.en: "It's a bit far, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "It's a bit far, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「んふふふ……大丈夫だよ、パパ。遠いほうが
　いいの」
dialogues.en: "Huhhh... Don't worry. It's better that way."
dialogues.text: "Huhhh... Don't worry. It's better that way."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにが大丈夫なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by that?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by that?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だって――」
dialogues.en: "Because..."
dialogues.text: "Because..."

dialogues.jp:
身体を回して、ぎゅっ、と俺に抱きつきながら
さくらが全身から喜びのオーラを発している。
dialogues.en:
Throwing her arms around me, Sakura radiates happiness from
her body.
dialogues.text:
Throwing her arms around me, Sakura radiates happiness from
her body.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ずっと、あなたと一緒にいられるもの」
dialogues.en: "I can be with you much longer."
dialogues.text: "I can be with you much longer."

dialogues.jp: ◆パパさんとデート♪◆
dialogues.en: ◆A date with papa◆
dialogues.text: ◆A date with papa◆

dialogues.jp:
翌日の日曜日、さくらとデートとして商店街を
散歩する。
dialogues.en:
The next day on Sunday, I had a date with Sakura at the
shopping mall.
dialogues.text:
The next day on Sunday, I had a date with Sakura at the
shopping mall.

dialogues.jp:
ハンバーガー屋でまた子供と間違えられたこと
で外見を気にしだしたさくらは、ふざけて俺の
ことをパパと呼んでくる。
dialogues.en:
When Sakura was treated as a child at the hamburger store,
she started to worry about her physical appearance. From
that reason, she called me 'papa' as a joke.
dialogues.text:
When Sakura was treated as a child at the hamburger store,
she started to worry about her physical appearance. From
that reason, she called me 'papa' as a joke.

dialogues.jp:
そして、出来るだけ長く好きな人と歩きたいと、
遠く公園まで行くことになった。
dialogues.en:
Sakura was happy that we could walk all the way to the park,
because it meant she can be with the person she loves much
longer.
dialogues.text:
Sakura was happy that we could walk all the way to the park,
because it meant she can be with the person she loves much
longer.
